subject: Request: On-prem BYOK handshake + HSM seal logs
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmefinancial.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acmefinancial.com
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request — on-prem BYOK handshake and HSM seal logs

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the call earlier. As part of Acme Financial's SIG review for Redwood Private, we need the following artifacts for our security team and external auditor:

- A copy of the BYOK handshake logs for customer key import during on-prem installation (time range: Feb 1–Mar 10, 2027).
- HSM seal/unseal event logs and attestation for the HSM appliance used in the on-prem package (certificate or PDF attestation).
- Network config snippet that shows the control-plane connectivity used during the key exchange (we only need the snippet, not full network diagrams).

Can you provide these as files or a secure Drive link? If any items are restricted, let me know what we can substitute (e.g., redacted logs + signed attestation). Our auditor needs this by EOD Mar 15.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Security Engineering Manager — Acme Financial
samir.patel@acmefinancial.com
+1 (415) 555-0193
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmefinancial.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — on-prem BYOK handshake and HSM seal logs

Hi Samir,

Appreciate the list — we can provide the artifacts. Quick notes before we assemble:

- BYOK handshake logs: these include customer key import operations. We will redact key material and export only the handshake metadata (timestamps, key IDs, import status, operator). We will provide a hashed index so you can correlate items.
- HSM attestation: our on-prem HSM vendor issues a signed PDF attestation (certificate chain and seal/unseal event entries). I will attach the vendor attestation and a filtered event log.
- Network snippet: provide a YAML snippet showing control-plane hostnames and ports (no internal IPs).

I will assemble and upload to a shared Drive folder and send a DocuSign attestation where required. Looping in Laura for legal/PRIV redaction guidance and Vivek for approval on handing over attestations to auditors.

Deliverable ETA: Mar 13 EOD PST for initial packet; will prioritize the handshake index first.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — on-prem BYOK handshake and HSM seal logs

Irene — quick flags from legal/compliance:

- Ensure we do not include any sensitive customer identifiers in the exported logs (use customer_id hash).
- The HSM vendor attestation is okay to share; redact any vendor internal serials that are not required by the auditor.
- Add a one-paragraph attestation from Redwood that the logs are unmodified exports and describe the redaction approach. This should be signed by CS or Security.

Marissa, can you prep the attestation template? Vivek — please confirm you approve release of the vendor attestation PDF to Acme.

Laura
VP, Legal & Trust
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmefinancial.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 13 Mar 2027 17:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Evidence packet for Acme — BYOK handshake + HSM attestation (attachments)

Hi Samir — attaching the initial packet per your request. Files included:

- byok-handshake.log (redacted; includes hashed customer_id, key_id, timestamps, operator, import_status)
- hsm-seal-attestation-20270313.pdf (vendor-signed attestation; vendor serials partially redacted)
- network-seal-config.yaml (control-plane connectivity snippet)

A few implementation notes included in the attached README inside the Drive folder: we exported the logs directly from the on-prem control plane, removed all plaintext key material, and produced a SHA256 index (byok-handshake.index.sha256) so your auditor can verify file integrity.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bBYOK-logs
DocuSign (Redwood attestation): https://app.docusign.com/envelope/example-id-12345

If your auditor needs the full unredacted logs under an NDA, we can coordinate a secure transfer and additional controls — please confirm.

Thanks,
Irene
[attachments: byok-handshake.log (log/plaintext redacted), hsm-seal-attestation-20270313.pdf (application/pdf), network-seal-config.yaml (text/yaml)]
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmefinancial.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmefinancial.com, SIG Review <sig-review@cloudsigreview.org>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence packet for Acme — BYOK handshake + HSM attestation (attachments)

Irene (and team) — received and reviewed the packet. Quick confirmation:

- The handshake index SHA256 matches on our side.
- HSM attestation PDF is satisfactory for our auditor; they requested the vendor chain which was included — thanks for redacting the vendor internals.
- The attestation signed via DocuSign is sufficient for our SOC3 binder.

We may ask for a brief (15 min) walkthrough with your security engineer next week to review the log fields and the redaction approach. Can you suggest availability?

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Samir
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmefinancial.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 15:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence packet for Acme — BYOK handshake + HSM attestation (attachments)

Thanks Samir — glad it worked. Marissa will run the 15-min walkthrough; she has availability Tue/Wed 10–12 PT. Marissa — can you take the lead and include a short slide that explains the handshake fields (key_id mapping, import_status values, operator_id hashing)?

We will keep the Drive folder pinned and will provide an NDA-assisted transfer if your auditor later requests unredacted logs.

Cheers,
Irene
